card.name: Reviewer credit lines in patient articles
card.fires_on: The word Review, Reviewed, Also or the colon in the reviewer credit lines at the end of patient-education pages, right before a named MD reviewer or the review provider.

modes.label: Review date and reviewer line
modes.description: The word Review, Reviewed or By just after a citation, in the review date and reviewed-by footer.
modes.example: Practice. 5th ed. Philadelphia, Pa: Elsevier Churchill Livingstone; 2008:chap 164. |<<Review>> Date: 2/8/2

modes.label: Also reviewed by / Review provided by
modes.description: Also or Review starting a sentence right after an author's credentials and affiliation.
modes.example: Yi-Bin Chen, MD, Leukemia/Bone Marrow Transplant Program, Massachusetts General Hospital.<< Also>> reviewed by David Zieve, MD,

card.writes: The promoted words (survivors, survive) look unrelated to this pattern, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the word Review or Also in the reviewer credit lines at the bottom of health information pages.
